description: Add kiro-cli as a new agent provider throughout the steamtrain codebase. kiro-cli is Anthropic-backed (like amp), emits Claude Code-compatible stream-json output, and uses the same message-level format (no partial stream_event deltas). The binary is 'kiro' and it uses '--print --output-format stream-json --verbose --model MODEL' args similar to Claude Code but without --include-partial-messages (it only emits message-level events like amp).
steps: 1. Add 'kiro' to the AgentProviderId union type in src/types/events.ts: change the type to include '"kiro"'.

2. Create src/types/raw-kiro.ts: reuse Claude's schemas (like amp does) by re-exporting claudeEnvelope, claudeAssistant, claudeMessage, claudeContentBlock, claudeUser as kiro aliases. Add kiroSystemInit (type:'system', subtype:'init' with session_id, model, tools), kiroUsage (Anthropic-shaped), and kiroResult (same as Claude's result shape but with optional 'error' string like amp).

3. Create src/agents/kiro.ts: implement KiroCliAdapter class (id='kiro', binary default 'kiro', defaultModel='sonnet'), createKiroMapper function (message-level mapper like amp: system/init->session_start, assistant text/thinking->text_delta, assistant tool_use->tool_use, user tool_result->tool_result, result->result+error, unknown passthrough), KIRO_MODELS array (sonnet='Sonnet (latest)', opus='Opus (latest)', haiku='Haiku (latest)', claude-sonnet-5='Claude Sonnet 5', claude-opus-4-8='Claude Opus 4.8', claude-haiku-4-5='Claude Haiku 4.5'), buildKiroExecArgs function. The adapter run() uses: --print --output-format stream-json --verbose --model MODEL [--effort EFFORT] [extraArgs].
4. Update src/agents/config.ts: add 'kiro' to AGENT_PROVIDER_IDS array and DEFAULT_AGENT_BINARY record.

5. Update src/agents/models.ts: add 'kiro' to AGENT_IDS array, import KiroCliAdapter and KIRO_MODELS, add kiro case to modelsForProvider switch, add kiro case to effortsForModel (reuse claudeEfforts logic since kiro uses same Anthropic models), add kiro to PROVIDER_ADAPTERS record.
6. Update src/agents/index.ts: import and export KiroCliAdapter, KIRO_MODELS, createKiroMapper, buildKiroExecArgs from './kiro'. Add 'kiro' case to createAdapter switch.
7. Update src/config/types.ts: add 'kiro' to the agentProviderId z.enum array. Add 'kiro: nonEmptyString.optional()' to the binaries z.object in configFileSchema.

8. Update src/doctor/doctor.ts: add kiro case to installHint ('Install Kiro CLI (npm i -g @anthropic-ai/kiro-cli) and ensure `kiro` is on PATH.') and authHint ('Run `kiro` and authenticate, or set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.').
9. Update src/tui/workflow-spec-ui.ts: import KIRO_MODELS from '../agents' and add 'kiro' case to staticModelName switch.

10. Create tests/kiro-adapter.test.ts following the pattern of tests/amp-adapter.test.ts: test createKiroMapper with sample init/assistant/user/result lines, test buildKiroExecArgs, test malformed input handling.
11. Update tests/models.test.ts: add a 'kiro models' describe block testing modelIdsForAgent('kiro'), defaultModelForAgent('kiro'), effortsForModel('kiro', ...) for the supported models.
12. Update tests/doctor.test.ts: add a 'checkAgent kiro' describe block testing binary_missing with install hint containing 'kiro-cli'.
13. Update tests/agent-config.test.ts: update the assertion that resolveAgentInstances() returns ['claude', 'opencode', 'codex', 'amp'] to also include 'kiro'.
14. Run `bunx biome check --write .` to fix any formatting issues, then verify all tests pass with `bunx vitest run`, lint passes with `bunx biome check .`, and types pass with `npx tsc --noEmit`.
acceptance_criteria: AgentProviderId type includes 'kiro' and all TypeScript compilation passes with no errors
createKiroMapper correctly maps system/init, assistant text, assistant thinking, assistant tool_use, user tool_result, result success, result error, and unknown events
KIRO_MODELS includes at minimum sonnet, opus, haiku aliases and full model IDs
Config validation accepts 'kiro' as an agent provider and in binaries
Doctor reports install hint for kiro with npm package name
All existing 1052 tests continue to pass
New kiro-specific tests pass (mapper, args, doctor, models)
Biome lint passes with no errors
TypeScript typecheck passes with no errors
findings: All 1071 tests pass (19 new kiro-specific tests added). Also had to update src/tui/draft-model.ts DRAFT_AGENT_ORDER array to include kiro, as TypeScript narrowed the tuple type and rejected AgentProviderId (which now includes kiro) in indexOf calls. Post-review fix: added --include-partial-messages flag to buildKiroExecArgs so the CLI emits thinking content blocks in stream output (mirrors Claude Code pattern). Speculative model catalog and draft-order-last are acceptable by design.
